metadata.title: Cinematic Studio Portrait with Scratched Lettering

retrievalProfile.description: A dual-layered composition featuring an extreme close-up portrait juxtaposed with a full-body silhouette on a film set, tied together by raw, hand-scratched typography.
excludeWhen: clean minimalist sans-serif typography is needed
the subject must be fully lit without shadows

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white composition where a large-scale, detailed facial crop on the left transitions into a dark void, revealing a smaller silhouette of the same figure standing amidst studio lighting equipment on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the macro face and the distant silhouette
Interaction between the subject and industrial studio hardware
Textural tension between smooth photographic gradients and jagged lettering
Balance of deep blacks and blown-out white highlights
coreInvariants: Presence of studio lighting rigs as graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up of a face occupies the left 40% of the frame; a full-body silhouette stands in the lower right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The detailed eye of the large-scale portrait serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large eye on the left, across the dark center to the silhouette and lighting rig on the right, then down to the bottom-aligned text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of solid black in the center to separate the two scales of the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for shadows and silhouettes
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for studio background and highlights
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted sepia or warm grey midtones
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation with extreme value range from 0 to 100.

letterConstructionRules: Jagged, uneven strokes mimicking a scratched surface
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'A' and 'W' have elongated, sharp terminals
Crossbars are often disconnected or slanted

composition.relationshipToImage: integrated as if scratched onto the negative

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive hand-drawn style used for both name and title to maintain raw aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, unpolished energy of the original lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast B&W photo. Left side: extreme close-up of a man's face, focused on one eye. Right side: a silhouette of the same man standing in a bright studio space with professional lighting rigs and cables visible. Center: deep black shadow transition.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-scratched, all-caps white lettering at the top and bottom. The text should look like it was carved into a physical photograph with a needle.

verificationChecks: Is the left eye sharp and detailed?
Is the right-side figure a clean silhouette?
Does the text look hand-scratched rather than typed?

adjustableVariables: Density of the studio equipment on the right
Aggression level of the scratched text
mustRedesign: Do not use soft, even lighting; must be high-contrast

mustAchieve: Clear distinction between the two subject scales

postGenerationChecks: Verify the 'scratched' texture of the font
Ensure the studio equipment is recognizable but stylized
Confirm the dual-scale composition is balanced
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Extreme Close-up Portrait] + [Distant Silhouette on Film Set] + [Hand-Scratched Typography] in a [High-Contrast Monochrome] palette.
